g.text: Fleet — Runtime: how it actually runs (tmux casts, --system composition, worktrees, conv-ids)

text.tspan: Every box is a `claude-sdk-cli` cast: identity via --system (actor + role, composed at launch), work via --prompt (skills + mission), and a conv-id as the durable anchor.
The Planner stands up Handler windows; the Handler's Router splits the Operator and Supervisor panes inside its own window.
The Supervisor runs in a standalone repo on purpose — a third party shouldn't inherit the operator's context.
